description: This file contains a distributed model benchmarking and profiling script using PyTorch, with support for various configurations such as DDP, FSDP, Dynamo, and profiling tools. It includes functions for visualization, profiling, and running models with different setups, and handles command-line arguments for configuration.

methods.name: torchviz_model
methods.description: Generates a visualization of the model's autograd graph using torchviz and saves it as a dot file if rank is 0.

methods.name: profile_model
methods.description: Profiles the model's forward and backward passes using torch.profiler and exports a Chrome trace if rank is 0.

methods.name: run_model
methods.description: Sets up the environment, applies model parallelism, runs warmup and timed iterations, optionally visualizes and profiles, then cleans up.
